evidenceKind: Node VM straight-line planner stub; not a browser or rendered rig take
integrationBoundary: Actual _tick receives 600 / 50 / 10 synthetic frames over exactly 10 seconds, with last timestamp pre-set to 1000ms.
The production <=25ms subdivision is preserved; this is not a fixed-40Hz accumulator.
Each synthetic render additionally calls the actual planner with dt=0, matching the current production render call.
stubbedBoundary: Straight +X exit path replaces _exitPoint; phase is complete throughout, with active=true and paused/reducedMotion=false.
Intent is held at 1; the actual scene movement branch advances at 0.60m/s.
Rig height=1 and figure height=1.15; gait metrics match the current rig at speed=1, intent=1.
Feet are pre-seeded at x=+/-.04m, y=.004m, z=+/-.0299m, so this does not validate _seedWorldFeet.
worldToLocal is an identity stub; requestAnimationFrame is inert; render performs no camera, WebGL, rig.update, or IK.
No phase transitions, terrain slopes, camera facing, reduced-motion UI, fallback, or browser scheduling are exercised.

metricDefinitions.swingStarts: A new swingAt value for either foot, including swings that start and finish between synthetic renders.
metricDefinitions.maxStanceLagMetres: Maximum root X minus foot world X whenever foot.mode is stance, sampled at every planner invocation.
metricDefinitions.strongStance: foot.mode is stance and stance load is at least .90.
metricDefinitions.maxContinuousStrongStanceWorldDriftMetre: World displacement between consecutive planner samples while the same foot is strongly planted in both.
metricDefinitions.floatingResidualSteps: Production while(remain>0) substeps below 1e-12 seconds, retained rather than silently removed.
